idea: Numbers & counting #1 (PLAYROOM): Baby Jimmy's tower of five colorful blocks topples over ('Oh no! My tower fell down!'); Ava kindly says 'Don't be sad! Let's build it again!', hands him the red block, and they rebuild it counting 'One, two, three, four, five!'; Ava points at the finished tower and asks the viewer 'How many blocks?' (pause) – 'Five! Five blocks! Hooray!'; copy-me: clap and count to five. Loop: the hook framing again, now the tower stands tall, bye-bye wave.
title: Oh No! My Tower Fell Down! 🧱 Count to 5 | Learn Numbers | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Jimmy's block tower fell down! 🧱 Baby Ava says "Don't be sad! Let's build it again!" – and together they stack the blocks and count: one, two, three, four, five!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! My tower fell down!"
🤗 Ava helps: "Let's build it again!"
🧱 One block, two blocks, three… they build the tower together
🤔 "How many blocks?" – can you count them?
🎉 "Five! Five blocks! Hooray!"
👏 Clap and count with Jimmy and Ava: one, two, three, four, five! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: counting from 1 to 5 • the number five • English words: one, two, three, four, five, blocks, count • when something falls down, try again together

A fun sing-along counting cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers – count the blocks, answer the question and clap along with Baby Jimmy and Baby Ava!

Kids cartoon • Counting song for kids • Numbers 1 to 5 • Learn to count • Nursery rhymes • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning
